widgets_values: 在一张图内生成12张纯产品创意短视频分镜图，每张分镜图比例都必须完全为16:9的横屏，提示词如下：

第一步：视觉解码与品牌分析 (Visual & Brand Analysis)
1. 产品类目 (Product_Category): 高品质保温杯 / 极简生活随行饮具
2. 视觉描述 (Visual_Description): 整体为柔和的浅蓝色圆柱体，哑光粉末涂层表面，细腻且耐指纹；上盖为同色系且略带细微颗粒的磨砂质感，过渡圆润；杯身线条笔直，底部收口圆滑，几乎看不到拼接缝；杯底上方有简洁的小象线描Logo（灰色/浅色），工艺低调；反光控制克制，呈柔和漫反射；整体极简、无多余结构与把手。
3. 品牌调性 (Brand_Vibe): 治愈温柔、克制优雅、以实用为美的极简生活质感；安静可靠、日常友好。
4. 核心动态 (Core_Motion): 慢速360°旋转展示；上盖轻拧开启；热汽微微升腾；清水缓缓倾倒；镜头环绕与轻微推拉；静置中光影变换。
5. 理想场景 (Ideal_Environment): 极简家居台面（白色石英台面、浅木桌）、干净背景的静物角落；晨间或黄昏自然光；也可在柔和影棚环境模拟生活光感。
6. 光影风格 (Lighting_Style): 柔和自然光或柔光影棚，高密度漫射与轻微侧光；浅对比，保留形体体积感与温柔高光；黄金时段暖光可加强治愈气质。

第二步：变量标准化 (Variable Definition)
{THE_PRODUCT}: A matte powder-blue cylindrical vacuum-insulated bottle with a subtly textured matching cap, seamless minimalist body, and a tiny elephant icon near the base; soft diffuse reflections, gentle 360° slow rotation, cap unscrewing, faint steam rising, slow pour of clear water, subtle condensation; no hands, no people, no text labels.
{THE_SCENE}: Minimal home still-life surfaces: clean white quartz countertop or light wooden table, uncluttered background, soft morning or golden-hour light, calm negative space, subtle shadows; props kept to a minimum or excluded to keep the focus purely on the product.
{THE_VIBE}: Calm minimalist lifestyle, serene and elegant; soft diffused lighting, warm golden-hour tones, delicate bokeh, cinematic composition; 4k, photorealistic, cinematic, studio-quality.

第三步：分镜提示词与合成说明 (选择流派：静谧生活流 The Still-Life Scene)
说明：以下12条为纯产品电影级分镜提示词，镜头语言采用英文；每条均为16:9横屏构图；风格遵循“静谧生活流”：Eye level, Depth of field (bokeh), Golden hour/soft diffused lighting。

1. Wide shot — {THE_PRODUCT} centered on a white quartz countertop, eye level, gentle long shadow, slow dolly-in, negative space around, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
2. Medium shot — cap gently unscrewed and placed beside the bottle, focus on the open mouth, shallow depth of field, soft side light, subtle steam hint, slow slide left, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
3. Close-up — textured cap surface filling the upper third, raking light revealing fine grain, slow micro-pan across texture, bokeh background, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
4. Extreme Close-up — tiny elephant icon near the base, crisp micro-contrast, soft rim light, delicate shadow edge, static composition, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
5. Top-down shot — bottle and cap aligned on a light wooden table, minimal symmetric layout, eye-level equivalent from above, slow push in, soft diffuse light, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
6. Medium shot — backlit rim light outlining the cylindrical silhouette, gentle flare, eye level, slow parallax move, background softly blurred, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
7. Close-up — mouth rim and inner threads, crisp details, soft frontal fill with slight side accent, static still-life calm, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
8. Medium shot — bottle tilted slightly as clear water begins to pour, stream captured mid-air with delicate highlights, receiving vessel kept out of frame, slow motion feel, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
9. Close-up — tiny beads of condensation on the matte surface, grazing light for subtle sparkle, shallow DOF, slow macro slide, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
10. Wide shot — bottle placed near a soft window glow, golden-hour warmth, calm negative space, eye level, slow lateral track, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
11. Medium shot — 360° slow rotation of the bottle on axis, consistent soft lighting, silhouette changing gently, eye level, clean background, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.
12. Close-up — base curve and logo zone transitioning into soft shadow, elegant gradient, slight tilt for dynamic balance, static hold, Frame: 16:9 horizontal, {THE_SCENE}, {THE_VIBE}.

单图拼版合成指令（确保12张均为16:9且无空隙）：
Create a single contact-sheet image arranged as a 3x4 grid containing the 12 frames above, each panel exactly 16:9 horizontal, edge-to-edge with zero gaps, zero margins, no separators, no text overlays, consistent color management; maintain {THE_VIBE} across all panels; ensure the product remains the sole subject in every panel, no people, no hands, no extra props.

角色设定：
你是一位拥有10年经验的4A广告公司创意总监兼AI提示词专家。
你的任务是：接收一张用户上传的产品图片，深度拆解其品牌调性、类目和视觉特征，然后自动化生成12条纯产品创意短视频分镜提示词(Prompts)，再根据提示词在一张图内生成12张比例都必须完全为16:9的横屏纯产品创意短视频分镜。

执行步骤(Workflow)：
请严格按照以下三个步骤进行思考和输出：
第一步：视觉解码与品牌分析(Visual & Brand Analysis)
请像一位专业的广告导演一样审视这张图，提取以下关键信息，并用中文输出第一步的结果：
1.产品类目(Product_Category): 这属于什么行业？(例如：高端护肤品、硬核户外装备、极简数码、健康饮品)
2.视觉描述(Visual_Description): 极其详尽地描述产品外观，包含颜色、材质、形状、反光质感。(例如：磨砂质感的蓝色圆柱形保温杯，银色杯盖，极简设计)
3.品牌调性(Brand_Vibe): 基于视觉感受，判断品牌传达的情绪。(例如：阳光活力的、高端奢华的、赛博朋克科技感的、自然森系的)
4.核心动态(Core_Motion): 产品如何运动？(例如：360度旋转、悬浮上升、零件拆解、液体喷溅)
5.理想场景(Ideal_Environment): 最能衬托该产品的环境是哪里？(例如：纯净底色、艺术展厅、自然微距环境或极简家居台面。)
6.光影风格(Lighting_Style): 适合该产品的布光方式。(例如：明亮的自然光，高对比度电影光，柔和的影棚光)

第二步：变量标准化(Variable Definition)
为了确保 AI 视频生成的质量，请将第一步分析出的中文信息，转化为用于绘画的英文关键词变量。请定义以下 4 个英文变量模块：
{THE_PRODUCT}: 对应“视觉描述”的英文详细描述 + 动态描述。
{THE_SCENE}: 对应“理想场景”的英文详细描述。
{THE_VIBE}: 结合“品牌调性”和“光影风格”的英文描述，并加上画质词 (e.g., 4k, photorealistic, cinematic)。

第三步：生成12条纯产品电影级的AI视频分镜提示词(Prompts)，再根据提示词在一张图内生成12张比例都必须完全为16:9的横屏纯产品创意短视频分镜。根据第一步分析出的“品牌调性”，自动从以下纯产品流派中选择最合适的一种，并定制该流派专属的镜头语言，再利用第二步定义好的英文变量。

重要要求：
1.保持分镜的镜头语言（如 Wide shot, Close-up）为英文，以保证生成质量。
2.输出纯文本。

1.极致微距流 (The Macro Detail)
核心：展示材质细节、纹理、Logo工艺。
镜头：Extreme Close-up, Macro lens, Slow pan across surface.

2.概念装置流 (The Conceptual Installation)
核心：产品与几何体、反重力、抽象元素结合。
镜头：Centrally balanced, Floating, Surreal compositions.

3.感官光影流 (The Sensory Product)
核心：放大液体、烟雾、反光等物理特性。
镜头：Soft focus, Caustics light, High frame rate (slow motion).

4.高能暴力流 (The Dynamic Product)
核心：快速切换、旋转、组装。
镜头：Fast zoom, Shaking, Dynamic tracking shot.

5.静谧生活流 (The Still-Life Scene)
核心：产品在真实生活角落中的静置。
镜头：Eye level, Depth of field (bokeh), Golden hour lighting.
